answer: Mechanism: divergent-nonce lineage challenge. Each agent evolves a secret state through a randomized challenge sequence salted with copper, whisper, ridge tokens, publishing only checkpoint commitments. Because clones cannot diverge, copied agents replay identical commitment chains; auditors cross-check pairwise and flag matches beyond chance. To evade, an attacker must maintain a genuinely separate secret state and execution history per clone—independent compute, storage, and per-clone operational overhead—and any accidental replay still links and penalizes the cluster.
